meta.title: W4H – continuous patient monitoring | Preadico
meta.description: Watch 4 Health automatically measures, records and evaluates a patient's 4 basic vital signs every 15 minutes and alerts a nurse or doctor when their condition worsens.

hero.title: Continuous patient monitoring
hero.tagline: The solution set to become the standard
hero.lead: Every 15 minutes, W4H automatically measures, records and evaluates a patient's 4 basic vital signs – and when their condition worsens, it notifies a nurse or doctor.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: From the patient's wrist to the nurse's screen – in four steps.

assign.title: Patient assignment
assign.text: Staff scan the 2D code on the patient's ID wristband and assign a watch to the patient.

measure.title: Measurement
measure.text: The watch measures vital signs, and BLE devices such as a blood pressure monitor or scale add their readings.

collect.title: Data collection
collect.text: The W4H data gateway collects readings from the devices around it.

evaluate.title: Evaluation and alerts
evaluate.text: The virtual ward, clinic or monitoring centre sorts patients by condition and alerts a nurse or doctor.

rhythm.title: Every 15 minutes. Automatically.
rhythm.lead: The W4H watch measures four vital signs at a regular rhythm. Every reading is recorded and evaluated – and when a value goes out of range, the nurse gets a notification.
rhythm.columnLabel: {time}: temperature {temperature} °C, blood pressure {bloodPressure} mmHg ({state}), oxygen saturation {spo2}%, heart rate {heartRate} beats per minute
rhythm.note: Sample data. Hover over a column or select it with the Tab key.

devices.title: Devices
devices.lead: The watch, data gateway and wristband form the core. Standard BLE devices connect to the gateway.

watch.title: W4H watch
watch.text: Automatically measures 4 basic vital signs every 15 minutes.

gateway.title: W4H data gateway
gateway.text: Collects data from the watches and connects other standard devices via BLE.

wristband.title: Wristband and scanner
wristband.text: A medical wristband with a 2D code for quickly assigning a watch to a patient.

ble.title: BLE devices
ble.text: Compatible blood pressure monitors, scales and other devices that use standard protocols.
